text: 4 The third is that remarkable flop in the extent of the rain northward, when the fun, that has concluded the vapour from the lines, and should form now more than ever to be in poffelion of them, is here over-ruiled suddenly; till, on its return to Corrir, again it returns the abloid command over the rain, and reconciledts it to the Line, to ten filn秆 de- lages to the forthand.?

parsed.modern: The third is that remarkable flop in the extent of the rain northward, when the fun, that has concluded the vapour from the lines, and should form now more than ever to be in possession of them, is here over-ruled suddenly; till, on its return to Corrir, again it returns the absolute command over the rain, and reconciles it to the Line, to ten furlongs to the southward.
